title: Funk–Jackson–Labbate–Sheehan conjecture on 2-factor Hamiltonian bipartite graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a $2$-factor Hamiltonian $k$-regular bipartite graph, meaning that every $2$-factor of $G$ is a Hamiltonian circuit. Let $K_{3,3}$ and $H_0$ be the two specified cubic bipartite graphs, and let a star product be the graph operation used in the construction described in the survey. **Funk–Jackson–Labbate–Sheehan's conjecture.** Either $k=2$ and $G$ is a circuit, or $k=3$ and $G$ can be obtained from $K_{3,3}$ and $H_0$ by repeated star products. A positive answer would characterize the family of $2$-factor Hamiltonian regular bipartite graphs.
source_name: D. Labbate and F. Romaniello, “An updated survey on 2-Factors of Regular Graphs”, arXiv:2408.04642 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.04642

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2024).
